name: Jetur
overview: Jetur is a male figure identified as the tenth-born son of Ishmael, belonging to the tribe named after him. Beyond his position as a son of Ishmael, there are no additional notes or distinguishing attributes recorded.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Jetur' is the sole name recorded for this individual. There is no specific meaning or divine origin attributed to the name in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jetur as a son of Ishmael, establishing his place within Ishmael's lineage. No further family relationships are detailed beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jetur's significance in the biblical narrative lies primarily in his role as part of Ishmael's descendants, contributing to the genealogical record important for understanding the broader family lines in Genesis. His mention underscores the fulfillment of God's promise to Abraham regarding Ishmael's progeny, marking the continuation of this lineage.
